## Added for the public repository

- `README.md` (from `scripts/release_templates/README.md`)
- `CITATION.cff` (from `scripts/release_templates/CITATION.cff`)
- `.gitignore` (from `scripts/release_templates/gitignore`)
- `data/README.md` (from `scripts/release_templates/data_README.md`)
- `LICENSE` (from `scripts/release_templates/LICENSE`)
- `LICENSE-DATA.md` (from `scripts/release_templates/LICENSE-DATA.md`)
- `src/agentto/_voxfem.py` replaced by `scripts/release_templates/_voxfem.py`: finds voxfem through `VOXFEM_SRC` or a plain import (the copy in `src/voxfem/`), and raises a clear error when it is missing
- `src/voxfem/`: the voxfem GPU finite-element and SIMP solver, copied unchanged from the authors' FEAD code, with its BSD 3-Clause license (`src/voxfem/LICENSE`)

## Dropped on purpose

- `README.md`: internal progress log; replaced in the release by a public README (scripts/release_templates/)
- `plan/`: planning drafts (plan, GUI plan, architecture notes, heuristic reviews): internal working notes
- `research/`: literature map, venue analysis, resource inventory and pilot scripts: internal working notes
- `sessions/`: local GUI development sessions (several GB); not part of any study
- `.claude/`: local agent settings
- `paper/README.md`: index of the internal paper folder (writing guide, venue notes); superseded by the README
- `paper/WRITING_GUIDE.md`: internal writing notes for the manuscript
- `paper/2026-10-31-submission-upgrade.md`: internal manuscript review notes
- `paper/archives/`: backups of earlier manuscript versions and pre-adjudication inputs
- `paper/_delivery_cleanup/`: internal delivery bookkeeping
- `paper/V5/`: manuscript sources (LaTeX, bibliography, PDFs, supplement, build scripts, cover letter); the public copy keeps the scripts of Figure 2 and the released-designs figure, and the frozen inputs and outputs of Figure 1 and the graphical abstract
- `paper/V1/`: earlier manuscript versions (V1 to V4 are not selected)
- `paper/arxiv/`: arXiv build of the manuscript; the preprint itself is on arXiv
- `paper/_audits/`: internal manuscript audit workspaces
- `paper/release/`: regenerated by this script (written into the staged copy fresh)
- `paper/adjudication/ADJUDICATION_SHEET.xlsx`: blank fill sheet, superseded by the filled final sheet; regenerated by scripts/make_adjudication_pack.py
- `paper/adjudication/ADJUDICATION_SHEET_prelim_2026-10-31.xlsx`: encoding of the preliminary verdicts, fully replaced by the final ones (the preliminary text file is kept)
- `paper/adjudication/*AgenticTO_adjudication_*.zip`: bundles of a blank sheet and copies of briefs and records that are already in the repository (all rounds)
- `paper/adjudication/round2/ADJUDICATION_SHEET_R2.xlsx`: blank blinded sheet; the filled one (ADJUDICATION_SHEET_R2_filled_SY.xlsx) has the same columns
- `paper/adjudication/followup/ADJUDICATION_SHEET_FOLLOWUP.xlsx`: blank follow-up sheet; the filled one (ADJUDICATION_SHEET_FOLLOWUP_filled_2026-11-01.xlsx) is kept
- `paper/adjudication/gnr/`: GNR-only pack, never filled; it was replaced by the follow-up pack, which covers the GNR records (paper/adjudication/followup/)
- `docs/guidebook/build/`: LaTeX build output of the guidebook; the PDF is docs/guidebook/AgenticTO_Guidebook.pdf
- `docs/USER_GUIDE.html`: HTML render of docs/USER_GUIDE.md (same content; the Markdown and PDF are kept)
- `scripts/make_fig_architecture.py`: main-figure diagram script (architecture); diagram scripts for flowchart, architecture and pipeline figures are not published
- `scripts/make_release.py`: author-side packaging tool; it holds the scrub patterns for the authors' local paths
- `scripts/release_templates/`: sources of the files written at the repository root (README.md, CITATION.cff, ...) and of the public src/agentto/_voxfem.py

## Left out by rule

- Density fields (`*.npy`), meshes (`*.stl`, `*.vtp`), session render PNGs, cross-check arrays (`*.npz`), console logs other than the X2 batch logs and the adjudication rescore log, discarded passes (`X2_draft1`, `X2_oraclebug`, `X2_claude_high_gcv_verifydefault`), scratch folders, caches, `node_modules`, files over 20 MB. They regenerate from the session logs by replay (given the solver); see `data/README.md`.
- Under `results/`: density fields (*.npy) 230 files, 4.42 GB; meshes and exports 132 files, 3.11 GB; renders inside session folders (*.png) 1244 files, 64.1 MB; runs from discarded passes 1007 files, 22.1 MB; scratch folders (work/) 690 files, 0.3 MB; console logs (*.log) 36 files, 0.1 MB; cross-check arrays (*.npz) 2 files, 0.0 MB.

## Privacy scan of the published bytes

- **local user name**: 2 matches in 2 files: `docs/USER_GUIDE.md` (1), `docs/guidebook/guidebook.tex` (1)
- **absolute Windows path (C:\ or C:/)**: 8 matches in 6 files: `docs/USER_GUIDE.md` (3), `docs/guidebook/chapters/ch02_install.tex` (1), `scripts/gui_screenshots.py` (1), `scripts/gui_test.py` (1), `scripts/make_user_guide.py` (1), `src/voxfem/sass.py` (1)
- **any e-mail address**: 2 matches in 1 files: `docs/guidebook/chapters/titlepage.tex` (2)
- **word 'Users' (path check)**: 1 matches in 1 files: `docs/guidebook/gen_tables.py` (1)

Allowed: any e-mail address in CITATION.cff, README.md; local user name in CITATION.cff, README.md (the authors' contact e-mail and the public repository URL). Remaining absolute-path matches are generic program locations or placeholders (for example the default Chrome location in the GUI test scripts, `C:/path/to/...` in the user guide); check them before publishing.
